fields.why:
- SO-811 Primary Ore Sorter MODBUS communications have been upgraded to provide PSD measurements (D10, D50 and D90).
- Displaying and trending PSD data will improve visibility of feed size distribution to the sorter.
- PSD data can be used to monitor crushing circuit performance and identify changes in ore presentation.
fields.design:
- Modify the SO-811 SCADA faceplate to display D10, D50 and D90 PSD measurements.
- Add historian tags and trending for the new PSD values.
- No control logic changes are required yet.
[Image in form – see source document] (SO-811 SCADA page mock-up with 'SO-811 PSD' D10/D50/D90 box)
fields.impact: CROs and metallurgists can see and trend SO-811 feed PSD, helping spot screen panel, grizzly and crusher wear.
